{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_with_custom.py:15:config-class"], "search": "    input_file: str = Field(..., cli=("-i", "--input"))
    max_records: int = Field(10, cli=("-m", "--max-records"))
    min_filter_score: float = Field(..., cli=("-f", "--filter-score"))", "replace": "    input_file: str = Field(..., json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-i", "--input")})
    max_records: int = Field(10, json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-m", "--max-records")})
    min_filter_score: float = Field(..., json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-f", "--filter-score")})", "explanation": "The test failure is PydanticDeprecatedSince20 for extra keyword arguments on Field (extra key 'cli'). Per the Pydantic V2 migration guide, extra kwargs on Field are deprecated and should be passed via `json_schema_extra`. The three Field calls now pass the same 'cli' tuples inside json_schema_extra={"cli": ...}, preserving the values. The class Config finding was already resolved by the existing model_config = ConfigDict(...) in the current content, so no change is made for it. ConfigDict and Field are already imported."}], "notes": "The reported failure comes from the three Field(...) calls that still pass `cli=` as a bare keyword argument. Those are the only edits proposed. They move `cli` into `json_schema_extra`, which Pydantic V2 documents as the replacement for extra Field kwargs. The `class Config` finding (config-class) is already fixed by the existing `model_config = ConfigDict(...)`, so I left it alone and did not undo that migration. Imports are unchanged because ConfigDict and Field are already imported. Caveat: `pydantic_cli/core.py` must read the CLI options from `field.json_schema_extra` (not the removed V1 `field.extra`) for the CLI flags to keep working. core.py is in the migration list but was not provided here, so I could not verify that."}
